headline: Central bank relaxes controls; home viewings up 20% in late September; fourth quarter gradually warming - Finance
summary: Real estate agencies reported September transaction volumes down less than 5% from August but more than 10% above last year. Agencies said the central bank slightly relaxed some credit controls in late September, and viewings rose about 20%.
why: Central bank credit controls on mortgages affect household borrowing and property demand, which feed into Taiwan's housing market and broader economy.
